name: Baseball
headline: circumference
description: A baseball is made of yarn wound around a small cork or rubber core and covered with two strips of white horsehide or cowhide stitched together. Major League Baseball's Official Baseball Rules require it to measure 9 to 9 1/4 inches around. It must weigh between 5 and 5 1/4 ounces.

measures.label: Circumference
measures.note: Rule 3.01: not less than nine nor more than 9 1/4 inches in circumference

measures.label: Weight
measures.note: Rule 3.01: not less than five nor more than 5 1/4 ounces avoirdupois

facts.text: Under Rule 3.01, players may not intentionally discolor or damage the ball, for example by rubbing it with soil, rosin or sandpaper.

sources.title: Official Baseball Rules, 2026 Edition (Rule 3.01 The Ball)

caveats: The rules give circumference, not diameter; any diameter shown is calculated from it.
